bib.title: Make Your LLM Fully Utilize the Context

question: How can a long-context LLM be trained to use information at any position in its context, overcoming lost-in-the-middle?
hypothesis: Lost-in-the-middle stems from insufficient explicit supervision during long-context training, which fails to show that any position can hold crucial information (a position bias from general training data); this is argued, not tested directly.
contributions: IN2 (INformation-INtensive) training: a data-driven fix using synthesized long-context QA data
VAL Probing: three probing tasks across document, code and structured-data contexts and forward, backward and bi-directional retrieval
Analysis of sliding window and RoPE base theta during IN2 training

method.summary: Synthesize 4K-32K token contexts by concatenating shuffled 128-token segments from C4 realnewslike, with GPT-4-Turbo QA pairs about one segment or multi-hop over two or more segments. Fine-tune Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.2 on the mixture for one epoch to get FILM-7B, then evaluate on VAL Probing, LongBench and short-context tasks.
method.task: long-context instruction tuning; long-context information retrieval and QA

datasets.name: IN2 training data
datasets.size: 1.1M fine-grained long-context (~63%), 300K integration/reasoning long-context (~17%), 150K short-context QA (~9%), 200K OpenOrca general instruction data (~11%)
datasets.source: Raw text: realnewslike subset of C4; QA generated by GPT-4-Turbo; OpenOrca
datasets.preprocessing: 128-token segments; context length evenly distributed 4K-32K via rejection sampling on random segments; 10-gram overlap filter against all evaluation data; ~10% of QA pairs kept with the original text Ci rather than a long context

datasets.name: VAL Probing (document, code, database)
datasets.size: ~3K examples per task, ~32K tokens per context
datasets.source: arXiv abstracts; StarCoder Python functions; Wikidata entities
datasets.preprocessing: Three lines of definition chosen per function

datasets.name: LongBench (9 tasks)
datasets.source: NarrativeQA, Qasper, MultiFieldQA, HotpotQA, 2WikiMultihopQA, MuSiQue, GovReport, QMSum, MultiNews

datasets.name: Short-context tasks (8)
datasets.source: MMLU, BoolQ, RACE-High, CommonsenseQA, ARC-Challenge, HellaSwag, GSM8K, MATH

other.note: starred results taken from Bai et al. 2023 and Lv et al. 2024

training.objective: instruction tuning: long context and question as instruction, loss on answer tokens only
training.hardware: 16 nodes of 8x80G A100 GPUs, PyTorch FSDP full sharding with CPU offload

other.ablation_subset: Section 4.3 experiments use 20% of the training examples

inference.decoding: greedy for all models and tasks
inference.samples: inferred: one greedy run per item; no seeds reported
inference.prompting: zero-shot instruction following for long-context tasks; 5-shot MMLU, 8-shot GSM8K, 4-shot MATH, 0-shot others

other.eval_tools: lm_eval for MMLU, BoolQ, RACE-H, ARC-C, HellaSwag; An et al. 2024 scripts for CSQA, GSM8K, MATH

metrics.name: VAL Probing Avg
metrics.definition: average performance across the whole context length
metrics.unit: % (word recall for document, exact match for code, relaxed exact match for database)

metrics.name: VAL Probing Gap
metrics.definition: max minus min performance over positions

metrics.name: LongBench F1 / ROUGE-L
metrics.definition: F1 for QA tasks, ROUGE-L for summarization, official scripts

eval.protocol: single run per model; no significance tests or seeds reported

prompts.text:
Generate one question and the answer from the given context. The question should be highly specific to the information provided in the context. It should not be a general question that suits any context.
Rules to follow when generate the question:
1. The question should be fully answerable from information present in given context.
2. Make sure the question is clear and unambiguous.
3. Phrases like 'based on the provided context', 'according to the context', etc, are not allowed to appear in the question.
Rules to follow when generate the answer:
1. The answer must use the information provided in the context.
2. Do not just copy words from the context. Answer the question in your own words.
### Context ###:
si
### Question ###:
{completion}

Generate one question and the answer from the given context. The context contains several pieces. Answering the question should require the reader to make multiple logical connections or inferences using **at least two pieces**. [rules as in Example 7; context given as Piece 1: s1i, Piece 2: s2i, ...]

[INST] Below is a context and an instruction. Based on the information provided in the context, write a response for the instruction.
### Context:
Li
### Instruction:
qi [/INST]

limits: Hypothesis about training-data position bias is not tested directly.
No seeds, variance or significance tests; single greedy run.
Only a 7B Mistral backbone and 32K context; ablations use 20% of data.
Needle-in-the-Haystack shown near-perfect for FILM-7B (Appendix C); VAL Probing authors' own benchmark.
Training data generated by GPT-4-Turbo; no weights or data release stated in the text beyond the GitHub link.
Starred baseline numbers in Table 2 are copied from other papers, so protocols may differ.

terms.definition: INformation-INtensive training: a purely data-driven solution using synthesized long-context QA that requires fine-grained awareness of a short segment and integration of information from two or more segments
the information being retrieved directly follows the retrieval keyword in a long context
VArious Long-context Probing: document, code, database tasks with bi-directional, backward, forward retrieval
